invoices.title: Invoices
invoices.clientPaymentsBanner: Collect from your clients online: email the invoice or open a payment link. Card and bank payments run through Stripe to your business. This is not for paying your own utility or credit card bills.

guide.title: Get paid online by your clients
guide.subtitle: Your client pays you for the job (invoice), not a utility company. Use the buttons on each saved invoice: email, text, share link, or charge online.
guide.step1Body: Add client name, amount, and due date. Save the invoice so it appears in your list.
guide.step2Body: Use Send by email, Send by text, or Share payment link. The client opens Stripe Checkout and pays with card or bank.
guide.step3Body: Money goes to your Stripe account connected to FieldBase. You will see the invoice marked paid when the webhook confirms payment.
guide.step4Body: If they paid offline, click Register payment and record cash, check, Zelle, or other methods.
